name: Noie Len Edeluk
original_name: ノイエ＝ルェン＝エーデルゥク
source:
A self-proclaimed beautiful and cute magical girl. Noie is a selfish and forcible person who suddenly pops into Seiji's ordinary life and starts taking care of him.

[Translated from [url=http://www.lunasys.info/?post_type=archive&s=%E3%83%8E%E3%82%A4%E3%82%A8]official website[/url].]
